name: mri_cardiac
description: Order a cardiac MRI for myocardial tissue characterization, cardiomyopathy evaluation, viability assessment, and congenital heart disease imaging.

region.description: Body region to image — focused on the heart

contrast.description: Contrast requirement — gadolinium for late gadolinium enhancement (LGE)

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., heart failure etiology, myocarditis, cardiac mass)

when_to_use: new-onset heart failure to determine etiology (ischemic vs non-ischemic cardiomyopathy)
suspected myocarditis (CMR with T2 mapping and LGE)

examples.query: Young patient with new heart failure, normal coronary arteries on catheterization

args.clinical_indication: new heart failure, etiology workup, ischemic vs non-ischemic
